omp-seed.label: omp settings seed
omp-seed.implies: Reviews settings this machine kept over the repository defaults. Local only: no secret, no network, nothing downloaded.

machine-key.label: machine key
machine-key.implies: Mints this machine's age key on an operator device and stores it in the repository encrypted to the admins group; atyrode apply places it.

operator-identity.label: operator identity
operator-identity.implies: Mints this device's own age key (inside the Secure Enclave on a Mac, a plain age file elsewhere) and prints the two clan commands that register it as a member of the admins group. Local only: no secret is read, nothing is uploaded, and the key never leaves the device.

agent-context.label: generated agent context
agent-context.implies: Writes this machine's facts under the operator policy to ~/.config/agents/AGENTS.md, which every agent tool here reads. Asks gh and clever for their session state, stores no secret, downloads nothing.

git-identity.label: Git identity
git-identity.implies: Materialises this machine's SSH auth and signing keys from Bitwarden and loads them into the agent. Needs your vault password once.

babel-archive.label: Babel session archive
babel-archive.implies: Generates this machine's storage document on an operator device from the repository password and the add-on credentials typed once; the next apply places it and arms the hourly timer that publishes sessions. No vault and no provider session on this machine.

omp-auth-broker.label: OMP auth broker token
omp-auth-broker.implies: Generates the bearer token the fleet's one OMP auth broker and every client of it share, on an operator device; the next apply places it, and the broker host serves with it while every other machine tunnels to that host. No vault and no provider session on this machine.

local-qwen.label: local-qwen model runtime
local-qwen.implies: Builds a Docker image and downloads about 40 GB of model weights. No secret and no vault, but it is the largest thing this machine will fetch.

manifold-agent.label: Manifold fleet agent
manifold-agent.implies: Enrols this machine with the Manifold hub named in fleet/manifold.json and stores the machine token it mints. Needs your vault password once.

bitwarden-session.label: a Bitwarden session
bitwarden-session.without: no secret can be read on this machine, so nothing the vault holds can be configured
